attachments.name: Wolf Tone Clapper
attachments.desc: A jagged fanged clapper that rings sour. Every ring hurts what it holds: half a swing's damage across the whole wave, more up close.

attachments.name: Iron Tongue
attachments.desc: A heavy iron clapper. The bell rings lower and holds zombies 70% longer, but the wave reaches only three quarters as far.

attachments.name: Mourning Veil
attachments.desc: Black funeral cloth wrapped over the bell. A muffled toll that carries 40% further, but holds them only two thirds as long.

attachments.name: Cracked Crown
attachments.desc: A broken iron crown on the bell's head. Tolls stack to five with a shorter window, and the Death Knell that ends them hits 50% harder and 20% wider.

attachments.name: Chained Bell
attachments.desc: Transforms the bell: it hangs from a length of grave chain. Longer reach, and the heavy becomes a flail spin that strikes everything around you before it rings.

attachments.name: Sexton's Lantern
attachments.desc: Transforms the bell: a gravedigger's lantern hangs under it. Every ring leaves a pool of ghost-light for 4 seconds that holds any zombie that walks into it.

attachments.name: Choir of the Dead
attachments.desc: Bone chimes round the rim. Every Death Knell kill lets a wisp go that drifts into the nearest zombie and holds it for 2 seconds.

attachments.name: Requiem
attachments.desc: A rosary of bone beads. Ringing near a downed teammate doubles your revive speed and keeps zombies off them for 4 seconds. Alone, a Death Knell heals you and wards you for 2 seconds.

attachments.name: Ossuary Grip
attachments.desc: Finger bones bound round the handle. Rings and bashes come 20% faster and the toll window lasts 30% longer.

attachments.name: Belfry Spike
attachments.desc: A coffin spike on the pommel. A Death Knell plants a spectral bell in front of you that tolls three more times on its own.

attachments.name: Rangefinder Optic
attachments.desc: The Grimhawk's boxy rangefinder: a red dot in a short tube. Slightly tighter zoom.

attachments.name: P.T. Expanse Mag
attachments.desc: A fan-shaped flechette drum: 35 rounds, a little slower to reload.

attachments.name: Reflex Sight
attachments.desc: A glowing dot sight. Slightly tighter zoom.

attachments.name: Extended Mag
attachments.desc: +50% magazine size.

attachments.name: Suppressor
attachments.desc: Much quieter shots. Kills are a little more likely to drop a power-up. −15% damage and range.

attachments.name: Red Dot Sight
attachments.desc: A compact red dot. Tighter zoom than the reflex.

attachments.name: Grip
attachments.desc: Hip fire spreads 45% less.

attachments.name: Drum Mag
attachments.desc: Double magazine size, slower reload.

attachments.name: Dual Mag
attachments.desc: Taped mags: reloads 30% faster.

attachments.name: ACOG Scope
attachments.desc: 4× scope with an illuminated chevron. +25% headshot damage.

attachments.name: Grenade Launcher
attachments.desc: Underbarrel 40mm launcher. Press 5 to switch to it.

attachments.name: Masterkey
attachments.desc: Underbarrel shotgun. Press 5 to switch to it.

attachments.name: Flamethrower
attachments.desc: Underbarrel flamethrower: sets zombies alight at short range. Press 5 to switch to it.

attachments.name: IR Scope
attachments.desc: Thermal scope: zombies glow white through it.

attachments.name: Variable Zoom
attachments.desc: Swaps the stock scope for a variable zoom: mouse wheel steps 4×–10× while scoped.

attachments.name: Holographic Sight
attachments.desc: A wide holographic window with a glowing reticle. Slightly tighter zoom.

attachments.name: 2× Reflex
attachments.desc: A reflex sight with a 2× lens: noticeably tighter zoom.

attachments.name: Laser Sight
attachments.desc: Tighter hip fire.

attachments.name: Hawkeye 3× Scope
attachments.desc: A long-eye scope for picking out targets for the flechettes. +20% headshot damage.

attachments.name: Long Barrel
attachments.desc: BO7's prestige barrel: rounds home from the hip instead of when aiming. +25% range.

attachments.name: Hollow Points
attachments.desc: More damage up close, less range.

attachments.name: Long Barrel
attachments.desc: Reaches further and hits a little harder.

attachments.name: Rubber Grip
attachments.desc: Tighter hip fire.

attachments.name: Tactical Stock
attachments.desc: Steadier hip fire.

attachments.name: FMJ Rounds
attachments.desc: Longer range and a little more headshot damage.

attachments.name: Quickdraw Grip
attachments.desc: Faster reloads.

attachments.name: Rapid Fire
attachments.desc: Fires 15% faster, each shot a little weaker.

attachments.name: Short Barrel
attachments.desc: Better hip fire, less range.

attachments.name: Light Stock
attachments.desc: Quicker handling and reloads.

attachments.name: Hot Loads
attachments.desc: Every shot hits a little harder.

attachments.name: Tuning Fork Reflex
attachments.desc: Two prongs ringing either side of a lilac dot. Steadier aim and a slightly tighter view.

attachments.name: MFS Deflection Core
attachments.desc: BO7's prestige magazine. Orbs ricochet off walls and leap from zombie to zombie instead of passing through, and fly 50% faster (about 48 m of travel). 9 rounds, slower to fire.

attachments.name: Overclock Cell
attachments.desc: A hot, finned cell that reaches full charge in half the time. Only 4 rounds.

attachments.name: Resonance Chamber
attachments.desc: Charging makes the orb bigger instead of faster: a full charge is nearly four times as wide, at walking pace, and clears a corridor.

attachments.name: Hush Baffle
attachments.desc: A fluted baffle that muffles the wail and the shot. Kills are a little more likely to drop a power-up.

attachments.name: Echo Rounds
attachments.desc: A fully charged shot leaves an echo: a ghost orb follows the same path 0.4 s later, at half damage, for no ammo.

attachments.name: Lancet Tear Grip
attachments.desc: BO7's raked grip: charges 15% faster and holds the charge while you sprint.

attachments.name: Soma-81 Grip
attachments.desc: A chunky rubber grip: 6% faster movement with the Siren in hand.

attachments.name: Ballistic Computer
attachments.desc: A green rangefinder screen on the rail. Draws the round's arc as you aim and rings where it will land.

attachments.name: Proximity Fuse
attachments.desc: Six seeker eyes on the muzzle. Stuck rounds arm after half a second and go off by themselves when a zombie walks up: the Havoc lays mines.

attachments.name: Kinetic Rail
attachments.desc: Copper coils round the barrel. Rounds fly much faster and flatter, and a round that sticks to a zombie hits it hard on the way in.

attachments.name: Napalm Rounds
attachments.desc: Each blast leaves a burning pool for 5 seconds that keeps hurting anything standing in it.

attachments.name: Redwell Dash
attachments.desc: BO7's skeleton grip. 7% faster on your feet with the Havoc in hand.

attachments.name: Extended Tube
attachments.desc: A longer magazine tube under the barrel. 8 rounds, slower to reload.

attachments.name: Cryo Rounds
attachments.desc: Blasts freeze: zombies caught in (or near) one slow to 40% for 4 seconds, and a zombie that dies frozen shatters. Slightly less damage.

attachments.name: Tripwire Spool
attachments.desc: Strings a laser wire from each stuck round to the one you fired before it (up to about 16 m, in line of sight). A zombie crossing a wire sets off both ends.

attachments.name: Mortar Sleeve
attachments.desc: Finned sleeve and an elevation quadrant. Rounds are lobbed high over cover; blasts are 35% wider and 20% harder.

attachments.name: Arc Rounds
attachments.desc: Each blast throws lightning on to up to five more zombies outside it, each link at 45% damage.

attachments.name: Bandolier
attachments.desc: Four spare rounds strapped to the stock. 50% more reserve ammo.

attachments.name: Daisy Chain
attachments.desc: Detonation sequencer. Your rounds go off one after another in the order you fired them, 0.12 s apart, each 15% bigger than the last.

attachments.name: Actuator
attachments.desc: BO7's hydraulic rear grip: a ram racks the pump for you. Fires 40% faster and reloads 15% faster.

attachments.name: Cluster Rounds
attachments.desc: Each blast scatters five bomblets that bounce and go off a moment later.

attachments.name: Breacher Stock
attachments.desc: Shock-absorbing stock. Your own blasts never hurt you; standing close to one throws you into the air instead (Havoc jumps).

attachments.name: Singularity Rounds
attachments.desc: A detonation first pulls zombies within about 10 m in for most of a second, then blows at 150% damage and 15% wider.

attachments.name: MFS Airstrike Mag
attachments.desc: BO7's prestige magazine. Rounds don't stick: they fly 40% faster, bounce off walls and airburst as they pass a zombie (or after 1.2 s). No detonator needed.

attachments.name: Gunner's Scope
attachments.desc: An armoured 4× box sight on the rail, like a vehicle gun's. +25% headshot damage.

attachments.name: Breach Reflex
attachments.desc: An open red dot on a tall mount. Aimed shots kick half as much.

attachments.name: Concussion Brake
attachments.desc: A flared, finned bell. The muzzle blast shoves zombies in front of you back several metres and staggers them for a second.

attachments.name: Thump Baffle
attachments.desc: A fat suppressor can: the crack becomes a thump. Less kick; with HE or Flak shells the blast is a little tighter but 15% harder.

attachments.name: Tungsten Rail Barrel
attachments.desc: Copper rails along the barrel. 50% more range, and the shell punches through one more zombie.

attachments.name: MFS Warhead Autoloader
attachments.desc: BO7's prestige magazine: a drum autoloader. Full auto, 15 rounds and a faster cycle, but a wider spread from the hip.

attachments.name: Damper Grip
attachments.desc: A rubber grip on a damped spring. 40% less kick and steadier hip fire.

attachments.name: Snap Grip
attachments.desc: A slim skeleton grip with a mag-release paddle. 20% faster reloads.

attachments.name: Hydraulic Buffer Stock
attachments.desc: Twin hydraulic cylinders in the stock soak 60% of the kick. Steadier from the hip.

attachments.name: Kick Stock
attachments.desc: A bare strut with a stiff spring and no buffer. Every shot shoves you back along your aim; fire at your feet to cannon-jump.

attachments.name: Bipod
attachments.desc: Folding legs under the barrel. Braced (crouched, prone or standing still): +40% damage, no kick, and a 15% bigger blast with HE or Flak shells.

attachments.name: HE Shells
attachments.desc: High-explosive shells: each bursts on what it hits (or in the air at the end of its range) in a small blast, trading 40% of the direct hit for it. Close blasts hurt you too, unless you have PhD Flopper.

attachments.name: Sabot Darts
attachments.desc: Tungsten darts instead of shells: each one goes through every zombie in line for 150% damage.

attachments.name: Thermite Shells
attachments.desc: Incendiary rounds: the ground where each one strikes burns for four seconds.

attachments.name: Flak Fuse
attachments.desc: Explosive shells with a proximity fuse: each airbursts beside the first zombie it passes, throwing shrapnel on ahead along its line, or bursts on what it hits.

attachments.name: Shock Shells
attachments.desc: Lightning arcs from where each round strikes to up to four more zombies.

attachments.name: Canister Shot
attachments.desc: A can of flechettes: the ROC becomes a shotgun. Ten pellets.

attachments.name: Tracer Mark
attachments.desc: Every zombie the round hits glows orange for eight seconds and takes 50% more damage from everything.

attachments.name: RL-7.62 Compensator
attachments.desc: A ported compensator. 25% less kick per shot.

attachments.name: Leyden Spark Belt Fed
attachments.desc: The overheat belt (BO7's prestige mag): a 500-round canister under the handguard, fed straight from your reserve so it never reloads, but about 55 rounds of sustained fire overheat it (a 1.9 s lockout) and its coils glow as the heat builds. Custom: when it overheats the stored charge leaps from the gun as lightning that chains through up to six nearby zombies.

attachments.name: R-556 Chief Barrel
attachments.desc: A heavy fluted barrel. 25% more range and a little more damage at distance.

attachments.name: VAS Foregrip
attachments.desc: A stubby vertical grip. 25% less kick, tighter hip fire.

attachments.name: Wessi Fast Belt
attachments.desc: A short 50-round belt in a slim pouch: 30% faster reloads.

attachments.name: Kepler Reflex
attachments.desc: An open reflex sight with a red dot.

attachments.name: Lucius-90 Grip
attachments.desc: A textured rear grip. Steadier hip fire.

attachments.name: Monolithic Suppressor
attachments.desc: Suppressed. Slightly shorter range, 10% less kick.

attachments.name: Fractal-LRB Barrel
attachments.desc: A long ribbed barrel. 40% more range, 15% less kick.

attachments.name: Enforcer Extended Belt
attachments.desc: An 85-round belt in a big pouch. Slower to reload.

attachments.name: Overpressured Rounds
attachments.desc: Hotter loads: 15% more damage and 10% more range.

attachments.name: Aegis-X40 Stock
attachments.desc: A padded heavy stock. 40% less kick, steadier hip fire.

attachments.name: Cryo Shroud
attachments.desc: Custom: a liquid-cooled barrel shroud. The barrel heats 35% slower and every hit chills the zombie (slower for 2 s; a long burst freezes it nearly still).

attachments.name: Accelerated Recoil System
attachments.desc: A lighter bolt: 20% faster fire, 20% more kick, and the barrel heats faster.

attachments.name: MFS Motion Strike Laser
attachments.desc: A side laser. 30% tighter hip fire.

attachments.name: Thermal Feedback
attachments.desc: Custom: the hotter the barrel, the harder each round hits, up to +50% damage just short of overheating. Sustained fire builds heat on any belt.

attachments.name: Titan Wield
attachments.desc: BO7's Season 2 conversion: a second XM325 in your left hand. Hip fire only, each gun runs its own 500-round belt (1,000 in the counter) fed from your reserve with no reloads and fires 25% slower for 40% less damage per round (together, 50% faster than one gun). Each gun overheats after about 50 rounds of sustained fire. No underbarrel or magazine attachments.

attachments.name: Waggle Scope
attachments.desc: A brass beekeeper's spyglass with a hex reticle and feelers. Aim at a zombie to mark it: every drone you have out goes for the marked zombie first.

attachments.name: Pheromone Laser
attachments.desc: A pink scent lamp under the muzzle. Nests lure zombies from twice as far, and drones go for the zombies near the pink dot.

attachments.name: Swarm Drum
attachments.desc: Swaps the comb for a six-bore drum of seed pods. Each shot is a spread of three small nests (three drones each, six seconds), up to six out at once. Double the magazine.

attachments.name: Personal Hive
attachments.desc: Swaps the comb for a straw skep: no more nests. Drones hatch from the gun and circle you (up to eight), sting anything that comes close, and a shot sends the whole swarm at whatever you aim at.

attachments.name: Smoker
attachments.desc: A beekeeper's smoker can where the barrel was. Each shot pours a cone of smoke that dazes zombies in front of you for 1.5 s and lobs the nest in an arc, and every nest already out empties all its drones at once.

attachments.name: Killer Swarm
attachments.desc: A black-and-yellow barrel ringed with venom stingers. Drones explode on their last sting.

attachments.name: Honey Trap
attachments.desc: A jar of glowing honey under the barrel. Every nest spills a pool round it: zombies wading through are 55% slower.

attachments.name: Queen Cell
attachments.desc: A royal cell along the top. Each nest's first drone is a violet queen: twice the size and damage, six stings.

attachments.name: Propolis Shell
attachments.desc: Resin-crusted bars round the comb. Nests take 2.5 times the beating before zombies tear them down.

attachments.name: Royal Jelly
attachments.desc: A canister of royal jelly strapped to the bellows. Drones that finish their stings fly back to you and heal you a little.

attachments.name: Akimbo
attachments.desc: A second gun in your off hand, fired in turn: twice the magazine and the faster dual-wield handling, but no aiming down sights. No optics or underbarrels.

attachments.name: Muzzle Brake
attachments.desc: Vents the blast sideways: 15% more range and steadier hip fire.

attachments.name: Quickdraw
attachments.desc: An exo-linked grip: 15% faster reloads.

attachments.name: Bulwark Plating
attachments.desc: Custom: armour plates that slide over the arm rigs when you lock down. Braced in lockdown you take 60% less damage (an amber shield edge shows it's up).

attachments.name: Hot-Swap Loader
attachments.desc: Custom: an autoloader in the fold. Switching between LMG and shotgun forms fills the new form's magazine from its reserve, so a form swap doubles as a reload.

attachments.name: Arc Rail
attachments.desc: Custom: an overcharged rail. Every hit throws lightning on to the 2 nearest zombies for half the shot's damage.

attachments.name: Ignition Coil
attachments.desc: Custom: a coil that superheats each shot. Hits set zombies on fire, burning for 40% of the hit's damage a second for 3 s.

attachments.name: Concussive Slugs
attachments.desc: Custom: heavy blunt slugs. Hits stagger zombies to half speed for 2.5 s.

attachments.name: Last Word
attachments.desc: Custom: a marked final round. The last round in every magazine hits for triple damage.

attachments.name: Incendiary Payload
attachments.desc: Custom: thermite in every grenade. Zombies caught in a blast burn for 30% of the blast damage a second for 3 s.

attachments.name: Advanced Rifling
attachments.desc: A precision-cut barrel: 30% more range and 5% more damage.

attachments.name: Foregrip
attachments.desc: A vertical grip: hip fire spreads 30% less.

attachments.name: Tracker
attachments.desc: Custom: a tracking laser. Every hit tags the zombie with a red marker for 4 s, and tagged zombies take 20% more damage from everything you throw at them.

attachments.name: Rapid Fire
attachments.desc: A tuned trigger group: 25% faster fire, a little wider hip fire.

attachments.name: Overclock Servos
attachments.desc: Custom: the arm guns' feed motors run past their limit while braced. Locked down, the XMG fires 40% faster.

attachments.name: Seismic Brace
attachments.desc: Custom: the arm rigs hammer into the floor when you lock down. Braced, every hit staggers the zombie to half speed for 2.5 s.

attachments.name: Capacitor Drum
attachments.desc: A 100-round drum on the LMG form, 25% slower to reload.

attachments.name: Rail Capacitor
attachments.desc: A bigger charge bank: 30% more damage per shot, 20% slower between shots.

attachments.name: Plasma Overdrive
attachments.desc: The heat sink runs open: 25% faster fire, 20% wider spread.

attachments.name: Grapeshot
attachments.desc: Heavier shot: 20% more damage, 25% less range.

attachments.name: Silencer
attachments.desc: Suppressed, at 10% less range.

attachments.name: Stabilizer
attachments.desc: A gyro-stabilised stock: hip fire spreads 20% less.

attachments.name: Scavenger Feed
attachments.desc: Custom: a reclaiming feed. Every kill with the gun puts 2 rounds straight back in the magazine (free, up to a full mag).

attachments.name: Auto Burst
attachments.desc: A converted trigger: hold to keep firing, 10% slower.

attachments.name: Laser Sight
attachments.desc: A green aiming laser: hip fire spreads 35% less.

attachments.name: Titan Slide
attachments.desc: A heavy slide weight: 35% more damage, 20% slower fire.

attachments.name: Kill Chain
attachments.desc: Custom: an adaptive trigger. Each kill within 3 s of the last adds 10% fire rate, up to 50%, until the chain breaks.

attachments.name: Speedloader Rig
attachments.desc: Two loaded speedloaders clamped on the barrel: 40% faster reloads.

attachments.name: Hunter Barrel
attachments.desc: A ribbed, ported long sleeve: 40% more range and 15% more damage.

attachments.name: Fan the Hammer
attachments.desc: Hold the trigger and fan it: fully automatic, 60% faster fire, 30% wider hip fire.

attachments.name: Trick Shot
attachments.desc: Custom: a headshot bounces on to the nearest zombie for full damage.

attachments.name: Recall Coil
attachments.desc: Custom: a magnet under the rail. A slug that goes through 3 or more zombies is pulled back into the gun: the shot costs nothing.

attachments.name: Overcharge Rings
attachments.desc: Custom: field rings at the muzzle. A slug's first hit bursts, 50% damage to every zombie within reach of it.

attachments.name: Double Lock
attachments.desc: A second hammer and flint: 25% faster fire.

attachments.name: Bayonet
attachments.desc: Custom: a spike under the bell. Your melee hits for three times the damage while this gun is out.

attachments.name: Bell Flare
attachments.desc: A wider brass mouth: a third more shot, 30% wider spread.

attachments.name: Ember Load
attachments.desc: Custom: hot coals packed with the shot. Hits burn for half the hit's damage a second for 3 s.

attachments.name: Chain Shot
attachments.desc: Linked balls: every pellet tears through 2 more zombies.

attachments.name: Cartridge Box
attachments.desc: A leather box on the stock: 50% more reserve ammo.

attachments.name: Breacher Choke
attachments.desc: A toothed choke: 40% tighter spread, 25% more range.

attachments.name: Side Saddle
attachments.desc: Spare shells on the receiver: 30% faster reloads.

attachments.name: Slam Fire
attachments.desc: Hold the trigger and work the pump: fully automatic, 40% faster fire, 30% wider hip fire.

attachments.name: Duckbill
attachments.desc: A flat spreader: a quarter more pellets, 35% wider spread.

attachments.name: Twin Feed
attachments.desc: Custom: chambers two shells at once. Every shot hits 80% harder and costs 2 rounds.

attachments.name: Shell Strip
attachments.desc: A spare strip on the handguard: 25% faster reloads, 25% more reserve ammo.

attachments.name: Bull Rush
attachments.desc: Custom: the first shot after a sprint hits for double.

attachments.name: Bipod
attachments.desc: Custom: folding legs. Aiming while standing still fires 30% faster, and aimed fire climbs half as much.

attachments.name: Cross-Feed
attachments.desc: Custom: kills in one form put 3 rounds in the other form's magazine.

attachments.name: Meltdown
attachments.desc: Custom: the core runs away with you. Keep firing and damage climbs to 50% more over 3 s; stop and it falls off.

attachments.name: Prism Focus
attachments.desc: Custom: a crystal in the bolt path. Each shot's first hit splits a bolt into the nearest zombie for 35% of the damage.

attachments.name: Grenade Bandolier
attachments.desc: Spare rounds on the stock: 50% more reserve ammo.

attachments.name: Cluster Rounds
attachments.desc: Custom: a blast that hits throws 3 bomblets that go off a moment later for 30% of the gun's damage.

attachments.name: Rotary Drive
attachments.desc: A motor on the drum: 35% faster fire.

attachments.name: Long Tube
attachments.desc: A longer launcher tube: 50% faster grenades, 20% bigger blasts.

attachments.name: Shock Anchor
attachments.desc: Custom: a charge ring on the rig. Locking down throws a shockwave that hurts and staggers everything within 220 units (6 s recharge).

attachments.name: Ammo Box
attachments.desc: A side box with a belt feed: 100 more rounds in the belt, 15% slower reloads.

attachments.name: Gun Shield
attachments.desc: Custom: an armour plate on the barrels. While the gun is firing you take 40% less damage.

attachments.name: Spin-Up Governor
attachments.desc: Custom: the barrels keep gaining speed. Hold the trigger and fire rate climbs to 60% faster over 4 s.

attachments.name: Cooling Jacket
attachments.desc: A finned jacket round the barrels: 30% more range, 25% tighter hip fire.

attachments.name: Overpressure Rounds
attachments.desc: Custom: hot-loaded cartridges. Every 5th round hits for double damage and staggers the zombie.

attachments.name: Field-Stripped
attachments.desc: Custom: a worn-in action, cleaned and oiled. Faster reloads, and the first 3 rounds after a reload hit 30% harder.

attachments.name: CQB Barrel
attachments.desc: Custom: a cut-down barrel for the crowd at the door. +30% damage within 250 units, -25% past 700.

attachments.name: Marksman Chamber
attachments.desc: Custom: a match-grade chamber. Headshots hit harder and put the round back in the magazine.

attachments.name: Penetrator Barrel
attachments.desc: Custom: tungsten-cored rounds through a tight bore. Shots go through 2 zombies, +20% damage for each one already passed.

attachments.name: Linked Belt
attachments.desc: Custom: a disintegrating-link belt. 25% more reserve ammo, and every 4th round is free.

attachments.name: Gunslinger Grip
attachments.desc: Custom: a grip made for the quick draw. For 2 s after you switch to this gun it fires 40% faster.

attachments.name: Thermobaric Warhead
attachments.desc: Custom: a fuel-air warhead. Bigger blasts that hit 20% harder.

attachments.name: Drone Uplink
attachments.desc: Custom: a buddy drone slaved to the gun. While you hold it, the drone shoots the nearest zombie in sight every 0.8 s for half of a hit.

attachments.name: Rhythm Trigger
attachments.desc: Custom (AK-12): keep the beat. Each hit in a row adds 4% damage, up to +40%; a miss starts over.

attachments.name: Tesla Rifling
attachments.desc: Custom (ARX-160): coiled rifling. Hits have a 15% chance to arc to 2 nearby zombies for half damage.

attachments.name: Adaptive Barrel
attachments.desc: Custom (Bal-27): the barrel learns. Each kill adds 5% fire rate, up to +30%, until you reload.

attachments.name: Splitter Choke
attachments.desc: Custom (HBRa3): a shot's first hit splits to the nearest zombie for 30% damage.

attachments.name: Triple Tap
attachments.desc: Custom (IMR): every third hit in a row on the same zombie hits for 2.5x.

attachments.name: Heavy Bolt Carrier
attachments.desc: Custom (AK-47): a heavier bolt. Harder, slower hits that stagger zombies.

attachments.name: Long Range Barrel
attachments.desc: Custom (M16): a long free-floated barrel. +20% damage on targets past 600 units.

attachments.name: Spoils of War
attachments.desc: Custom (StG-44): kills with this gun pay 30 extra points.

attachments.name: Overheat Vent
attachments.desc: Custom (AE4): the last quarter of a magazine runs hot. Those shots hit 40% harder and set zombies on fire.

attachments.name: Kinetic Pulse
attachments.desc: Custom (Repulsor): every 8th hit lets off a pulse that staggers every zombie within 150 units.

attachments.name: Match Trigger
attachments.desc: Custom (MK14): a crisp break. An aimed shot taken 0.4 s or more after the last hits 25% harder.

attachments.name: Thirty-Aught Clip
attachments.desc: Custom (M1 Garand): full-power .30-06 in an en-bloc clip. Shots go through a zombie and headshots hit harder.

attachments.name: Charge Chamber
attachments.desc: Custom (M160): aim for 1 s to charge the chamber. The next shot hits for double.

attachments.name: Frenzy Feed
attachments.desc: Custom (KF5): kills within 1 s of each other put 3 rounds back in the magazine.

attachments.name: Shredder Rounds
attachments.desc: Custom (MP11): each hit on the same zombie adds 5% damage, up to +50%.

attachments.name: Typewriter Spring
attachments.desc: Custom (ASM1): hold the trigger and the fire rate climbs, up to +40% over 3 s.

attachments.name: Bodyguard Plate
attachments.desc: Custom (SN6): a ballistic plate on the fore-end. 25% less damage taken while firing.

attachments.name: Sentinel Uplink
attachments.desc: Custom (AMR9): headshots mark every zombie within 200 units, and marked zombies take 20% more from your hits.

attachments.name: Static Discharge
attachments.desc: Custom (SAC3): every 20th hit discharges, arcing to 4 nearby zombies for full damage.

attachments.name: Blitz Bolt
attachments.desc: Custom (MP40): for 1 s after a sprint the gun fires 30% faster.

attachments.name: Lucky Magazine
attachments.desc: Custom (Sten): one round in ten doesn't leave the magazine.

attachments.name: Heat Sink
attachments.desc: Custom (Ameli): after 2 s of sustained fire, hits set zombies on fire.

attachments.name: Juggernaut Frame
attachments.desc: Custom (Pytaek): a braced frame. 30% less damage taken while aiming.

attachments.name: Volley Pins
attachments.desc: Custom (Lynx): each hit within 1 s of the last adds 20% damage, up to +80%.

attachments.name: Cryo Slugs
attachments.desc: Custom (MORS): hits freeze zombies to half speed for 5 s; a frozen zombie killed shatters, hurting those within 100 units for half the hit.

attachments.name: Spotter Scope
attachments.desc: Custom (SVO): aiming marks the zombies in view, and marked zombies take 20% more from your hits.

attachments.name: Explosive Tip
attachments.desc: Custom (Atlas 20mm): hits burst, hurting zombies within 120 units for 60% of the hit.

attachments.name: Buckshot Overload
attachments.desc: Custom (S12): 30% more pellets in a wider pattern.

attachments.name: Showstopper
attachments.desc: Custom (M1911): headshots stagger the zombie and every zombie within 120 units.

attachments.name: Double Tap
attachments.desc: Custom (MP-443): a second hit on the same zombie within 0.3 s hits for double.

attachments.name: Vampire Rounds
attachments.desc: Custom (PDW): kills with this gun heal you for 8 health.

attachments.name: Tandem Charge
attachments.desc: Custom (MAAWS): a second charge goes off 0.35 s after the first blast, for half its damage.

attachments.name: Arc Warhead
attachments.desc: Custom (Mahem): blast hits arc to the 2 nearest zombies for half damage.

attachments.name: Salvo Link
attachments.desc: Custom (Stinger M7): a rocket that kills puts a rocket back in the launcher.

attachments.name: Appraiser's Loupe
attachments.desc: A jeweller's brass loupe with a gold dot. Aimed hits bank 25% more debt.

attachments.name: Foreclosure Brake
attachments.desc: A padlocked muzzle brake. A zombie that owes more than its health is foreclosed: it shuffles at half speed until it pays.

attachments.name: Compound Interest Cylinder
attachments.desc: A fluted five-shot cylinder with a gear-driven counter. Interest compounds: 8% a second on everything owed, up to 150% (300% Pack-a-Punched).

attachments.name: Double or Nothing
attachments.desc: The cylinder becomes a roulette wheel that spins on every collection. Red: every debt x1.6. Black: the house forgives them all. The green zero: x4.

attachments.name: Repo Hook
attachments.desc: A chained grappling hook under the barrel. Collecting drags every surviving debtor up to 150 toward you and staggers it for a second.

attachments.name: Payday Clip
attachments.desc: A money-clip speedloader. Collections pay you 5% of what they collect as points (up to 100 a zombie).

attachments.name: The Bailiff
attachments.desc: Turns the revolver into a carbine: long barrel, walnut handguard and a wire stock. Double range, 30% more damage, a tighter aim, and every shot goes through to bill the zombie behind. No muzzle or barrel attachments.

attachments.name: Debt Spiral Barrel
attachments.desc: A barrel wound in a spiral of gold. Each further hit on a debtor banks 15% more than the last, up to 75% more.

attachments.name: Ticker Tape Laser
attachments.desc: A gold laser on a stock-ticker reel. 30% tighter hip fire, and a debtor's tag turns red once collecting will kill it.

attachments.name: Loan Shark Grips
attachments.desc: Sharkskin grips with a tooth on the butt. 25% faster reloads, and a melee on a debtor collects its debt on the spot.

_ironSightsNote: Iron sights (front and rear) removed when an optic is fitted, so the front post doesn't show through the sight window. On the M16/Commando the bone is the carry handle with the front post; on the FAMAS it's the handle. 2026-10-15: the BO3 imports whose stock sight is its own bone: SMG5, 93R tag_ironsight; RPD, MG4 tag_frontsight_up; MR23 j_rearsight (the 93R's tag_handle is its fold-down grip). MP7, AA12 and P90 sights are part of the receiver mesh (no bone), so they stay.
_levelsNote: levels: every gun with a Gunsmith has this many levels; its attachments are spread over them (first at level 2, last at levels-2) and the levels between are filler (no unlock: progression and prestige). padTo: guns with fewer attachments than this get stat-only generic ones (generic: true, no model) in the barrel / stock / grip / ammo slots, in catalogue order, until they have padTo. curve: XP to the next level = base * level^exponent.
